status: Declarative source of truth for RENEWAL-PLAN.md. Every numeric choice below is copied from that plan; nothing here was chosen after a trajectory was seen.
question: Can a finite, initially supplied nutrient reservoir support a retained source and new, metabolically maintained sites under the existing rule-1 dynamics? If so, is the paid polymer-retention mechanism necessary for that result among the four specified arms?

arms.description: Exact witness BUILD16 genome, ordinary polymer transport gate
Same genome with only b2(OUT.BUILD) changed from 16 to 0; feedback wiring unchanged
Exact previously selected nonbuilder; its stationary ranking is not claimed to hold in this habitat
Exact builder genome with polymerTransport:false; construction still consumes B and E

confirmation.habitatEligibility: at least one of the four arms has RENEW=true in the main pilot

endpoints.maintained: B_i >= V at every census from..to; Q_i(from,to) = sum of PHOTO+GROW at i >= Qmin; R_i(from,to) = net reaction change of B at i, bound transport excluded, >= Rmin
endpoints.renew: maintained(source, 9000, 10000) and maintained(j, 9000, 10000) for at least one same fixed site j outside the initial one-site footprint; all qualifying sites recorded

controls.capacity: both initialized sites have B >= 128 at all 11 censuses 2000..3000 and Q >= 128 in that window; R reported separately
controls.division: both initialized sites have B >= 128 at all 11 censuses 2000..3000 and Q >= 128 in that window; R reported separately
controls.small-founder: whether any one same site, including the initial site, satisfies maintained(i, 9000, 10000); all raw source and field outcomes reported

endpoints.spreadZeroInvariant: in spread-0 main cases every off-source B is exactly zero at every step; any off-source B is a technical failure
endpoints.confirmed: at least one same arm has RENEW=true in at least 4 of its 5 blocks
endpoints.constructionSpecific: in at least 4 of the 5 paired blocks the builder has RENEW=true, all three other arms RENEW=false, and builder and ablation both have positive recorded BUILD expenditure
secondary: local Q, R and bound-B imports
endpoints.secondaryRule: Secondary readouts explain a primary outcome and never rescue a failed primary gate. Observational masks are fixed cells, not declared organisms.

energyAccounting.status: secondary and explanatory; entered before the freeze at the evolvability-discovery workstream's request (PLAN Stage 1), no threshold or decision rule depends on it
energyAccounting.records: per-cell E at each census, cumulative bound-E gross import and export, cumulative E change by reactions, cumulative PHOTO, GROW, RESP and DECOMP
energyAccounting.inequality: for any window and site set with eA 0, eB 10, eC 2: 10*sum(GROW) <= E_start - E_end + 8*sum(RESP) + 2*sum(DECOMP) + net bound-E import

verification.cpu: complete replay; every census's hashes, ledgers, cumulative observer values and checkpoint digests compared
verification.gpu: native replay; every census's state hash, global ledger and flux, and last-step role digest compared against the CPU records

backend: CPU RefSim, primary, one case at a time; native GPU is an independent replay check only
